name: Lisdexamfetamine
description: A lysine-conjugated prodrug of dextroamphetamine requiring enzymatic cleavage in blood, approved for attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder and moderate to severe binge eating disorder. A Schedule II controlled substance with a boxed warning for abuse and dependence.

systems.note: Catecholamine release and reuptake inhibition; the labelled indications.
Blood pressure and heart rate elevation and sudden cardiac events are labelled.
Appetite suppression and weight loss are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled appetite suppression and weight loss.
Labelled psychiatric adverse reactions and the boxed dependence warning.
